title: Four Fuses and a Firework Barn
story: Embermoth the Fuse Chewer has lit four fuses under the festival firework barn. Mr 6 snips three of them at 26, 31, and 22 seconds of burn, but he must know the average burn of all four to time his water bucket spell exactly.
question: If the average of all four fuses must come out to 25 seconds, how many seconds did the fourth fuse burn?
hint: An average of 25 across 4 fuses means the four burn times add up to a certain total. Find that total, then subtract the three you know.
victory: Mr 6 douses the last fuse at exactly the right instant, and Embermoth — thoroughly out-averaged — flutters off to chew on something safer, like spaghetti.
imagePrompt: A moth with glowing ember wings perched on sputtering fuses beneath a barn full of fireworks, a number-six knight crouched with a water bucket and a stopwatch in the orange glow.
